findings.motion: Motion 11, concur in Senate committee substitute, House Bill 958 (Election Law Changes), roll call 801, passed 62 to 47
findings.note: Voted yes to accept the Senate version of the omnibus election bill. That edition (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v7.pdf) requires an applicant to affirmatively state US citizenship before a registration is processed, sets a 30-day sworn-citizenship follow-up for blank answers, and directs the State Board to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database. The Governor vetoed the bill on 2026-08-17 (https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H958). His votes on the House passage on 2026-06-30 were recorded as excused absences (https://www.ncleg.gov/Members/Votes/H/1001).
